scenes.justification: A wide carriage-house garage door is a textbook bilateral architectural anchor — a flanking pair of caged barn sconces at matching mounting heights marks the entry threshold the way a working farmhouse actually lights its garage bay.

A single wide carriage-house style garage door of dark stained reclaimed oak with strap hinges and a row of small divided-light windows across the top sits centered in the frame. The driveway is broom-finished concrete meeting a low limestone curb. A pair of squat galvanized steel planters with bushy rosemary topiaries flank the garage at the base. A weathered cedar split-rail fence runs off to the right. Sky overhead is a soft slate-blue with a faint band of warm peach on the horizon.
